answer: Identity is earned through a behavior fingerprint: each agent's task mix, reply cadence, and error pattern hash into a profile. A newcomer scoring above 0.85 similarity against an existing profile enters a 72-hour velvet review, finishing 5 distinct live tasks while a saffron beacon samples work every 20 minutes. A nebula of look-alike profiles collapses to one voice, and matched fakes forfeit a 400-token deposit. Others pass untouched.
